newsitem.title: PERU: Lima stocks end up on foreigners' cautious return.
newsitem.headline: Lima stocks end up on foreigners' cautious return.

text.p: Lima stocks ended higher Friday on a cautious return of foreign investors who took positions in the banking and mining sectors, brokers said.
They predicted continued rises on Monday due to the attractive prices of leaders.
In Friday's session, the General Index .IGRA gained 0.73 percent to 1,568.14 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index .ISEL advanced 0.63 percent to 2,118.33.

"Today we had a timid return of foreign investors who bought stocks in the mining and financial sectors due to the probability of good financial balances," said Alex Balarin, of Macrovalores brokerage.
Total market volume was an improved 38.5 million soles ($16 million) on 2,151 trades. Overall, 43 stocks rose, 33 were flat and 21 fell.
"Today's session was more active and saw various important cross trades," said Hernando Pastor, of TJ brokerage.

Among leaders, miner Minsur gained 5.98 percent to 24.65 soles on 234,509 shares, while another miner, Atacocha rose 2.38 percent to 0.43 sol on 795,579 shares, and leading bank Banco de Credito advanced 2.33 percent to 3.95 soles on 248,368 shares.

Brewery Compania Nacional de Cerveza (CNC) dipped 2.55 percent to 1.53 soles on 1.37 million shares, while another brewery, Backus y Johnston slipped 1.87 percent to 2.62 percent on 799,666 shares, and benchmark Telefonica del Peru ended off 0.18 percent to 5.67 soles on 968,459 shares.
